import math
def control(obs):
    h=obs['hitch_deg']
    cam=obs['views'].get('camera')
    if not cam:
        return (1.8*h,-0.35,-23)
    th=math.radians(obs['rig']['trailer_heading_deg'])
    ox,oy=cam['origin']
    rx,ry=obs['rig']['trailer_rear']
    sides=[[],[]]
    for b,d in cam.get('walls',[]):
        b=math.radians(b)
        dx=ox+d*math.cos(b)-rx
        dy=oy+d*math.sin(b)-ry
        s=-(dx*math.cos(th)+dy*math.sin(th))
        y=-dx*math.sin(th)+dy*math.cos(th)
        if 0.5<s<9 and abs(y)>0.7:
            sides[0 if y>0 else 1].append((s,y))
    L=4.0
    vals=[]
    for pts in sides:
        pts=sorted(pts,key=lambda p:abs(p[0]-L))[:7]
        if len(pts)<2:
            return (max(-34,min(34,2*h)),-0.3,-23)
        ws=[1/(0.5+(s-L)**2) for s,y in pts]
        sw=sum(ws)
        sx=sum(w*s for w,(s,y) in zip(ws,pts))/sw
        sy=sum(w*y for w,(s,y) in zip(ws,pts))/sw
        den=sum(w*(s-sx)**2 for w,(s,y) in zip(ws,pts))
        slope=sum(w*(s-sx)*(y-sy) for w,(s,y) in zip(ws,pts))/max(den,0.01)
        vals.append(sy+slope*(L-sx))
    y=sum(vals)/2
    curvature=2*y/(L*L+y*y)
    goal=math.degrees(math.atan(3.65*curvature))
    goal=max(-27,min(27,goal))
    steer=max(-34,min(34,0.75*h+1.8*(h-goal)))
    speed=-0.75 if abs(h)<15 else -0.5
    return (steer,speed,-23)

import math
pts=[]
px=py=yaw=0.0
last=None
def control(o):
 global px,py,yaw,last,pts
 t=o['t']; dt=o['dt']; v=o['motion']['v_mps']; st=math.radians(o['steer_deg'])
 yaw+=v*math.tan(st)/2.5*dt
 px+=v*math.cos(yaw)*dt; py+=v*math.sin(yaw)*dt
 c=math.cos(yaw); s=math.sin(yaw)
 for name,view in o['views'].items():
  if name not in ('left_mirror','right_mirror'): continue
  ox,oy=view['origin']
  for b,d in view['walls']:
   b=math.radians(b); x=ox+d*math.cos(b); y=oy+d*math.sin(b)
   if x < -3:
    pts.append((px+c*x-s*y,py+s*x+c*y,t,1 if name=='left_mirror' else -1))
 pts=[p for p in pts if t-p[2]<12]
 rx,ry=o['rig']['trailer_rear']; h=math.radians(o['hitch_deg'])
 # Estimate corridor centre ahead of the reversing trailer.
 samples=[]
 for wx,wy,tt,side in pts:
  dx=wx-px; dy=wy-py; x=c*dx+s*dy; y=-s*dx+c*dy
  if rx-5<x<rx-0.5:
   w=math.exp(-((x-(rx-2.8))/2)**2)*math.exp(-(t-tt)/5)
   samples.append((y-side*2.55,w,x))
 if samples:
  sw=sum(p[1] for p in samples); cy=sum(y*w for y,w,x in samples)/sw; cx=sum(x*w for y,w,x in samples)/sw
  err=(cy-ry)*math.cos(h)-(rx-cx)*math.sin(h)
  desired=max(-24,min(24,math.degrees(math.atan2(2*3.6*err,max(9,(rx-cx)**2)))))
 else: desired=0
 steer=max(-40,min(40,2.2*(o['hitch_deg']-desired)+0.5*o['hitch_deg']))
 look=64 if int(t/3)%2==0 else -64
 return steer,-0.55,look
